newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Perdigao upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Perdigao upgraded to buy.

text.p: -- Local bank Geral do Comercio said it is upgrading its recommendation for Brazilian food firm Perdigao S.A. to buy from hold.

-- The upgrading is "due to the reversal in the oversupply of chicken and pork and the concentrated impact of rises in soybean and corn prices in the second quarter of 1996," said bank analyst Lilyanna Yang.
-- She also cited in a research report the firm's improving bright second half prospects.
-- Despite a weak first half, stronger figures in 1996's second six months should allow the firm to end the year with an estimated net profit of 24.2 million reais, she added.
-- The bank estimates Perdigao will show earnings of 53.3 million reais next year and 62.1 million reais in 1998.
-- Geral do Comercio has set a 2.40-real 12-month target price, indicating a potential 56 percent growth in share value, the report said.
-- Perdigao's preferred was unchanged at 1.54 reais at 1631 local/1931 gmt on the Sao Paulo bourse.
